en.headline: Hip Shing Hong sells Central shop held for 55 years
en.dek: A ground-floor unit on Arbuthnot Road changed hands last month for 21.4 million dollars, the Post reported.
body: Hip Shing Hong has sold a ground-floor shop in Central that it had held for 55 years, the South China Morning Post reported on Friday, citing Land Registry data.

The shop is at Arbuthnot House, 10-12 Arbuthnot Road, and has a gross area of about 1,474 square feet. It changed hands late last month for 21.4 million Hong Kong dollars, or about 14,518 dollars a square foot, the paper said. It is leased to the private members’ club Salon No. 10.

The buyer was described as an heir of the Swiss underwear maker Triumph. The company did not immediately respond to the Post. Analysts quoted by the paper called the use of overseas capital for a local retail unit highly unusual.

zh.headline: 協成行沽出持有55年中環地舖
zh.dek: 《南華早報》引土地註冊處資料稱，亞畢諾道地舖上月底以2140萬元易手。
body: 《南華早報》周五引述土地註冊處資料報道，本地發展商協成行沽出一間持有55年的中環地舖。
舖位位於亞畢諾道10至12號亞畢諾大廈地下，建築面積約1474平方呎，上月底以2140萬港元成交，呎價約14518元。現租予私人會所Salon No. 10。
報道形容買家是瑞士內衣品牌黛安芬的一名繼承人。公司未有即時回應早報查詢。報道引述分析指，以外資購入本地零售物業並不常見。
